# Agent Instructions

## Generated files — do NOT edit directly

`sw.js` is **auto-generated** by `scripts/generate-sw.js`. The deploy workflow runs `node scripts/generate-sw.js` which overwrites `sw.js` on every deploy. Any changes made directly to `sw.js` will be silently lost.

To change service worker behavior, edit the template string inside `scripts/generate-sw.js`, then run `node scripts/generate-sw.js` to regenerate.

If new files or directories are added to the repo that should NOT be cached by the service worker, add them to the `EXCLUDE` set in `scripts/generate-sw.js`.

`.github/workflows/deploy.yml` is generated by `scripts/deploy.sh` via a heredoc. Edit the heredoc in `deploy.sh`, not the workflow file directly. Running `deploy.sh` will overwrite it.

## Design tokens — keep wallet and keyguard in sync

The design language ("instrument panel": flat surfaces, hairline rules, one
shadow level for true overlays, mono tabular figures for all amounts) lives in
a token block between `/* == DESIGN TOKENS ... == */` sentinel comments at the
top of BOTH `src/styles/app.css` and `keyguard/src/styles/keyguard.css`. The
two origins cannot share a file at runtime, so the blocks are duplicated —
**any token change must be made in both files**. `scripts/generate-sw.js`
compares the blocks (comments ignored) and warns on drift at every deploy.
Dark mode redefines only the base color tokens; all tints derive via
`color-mix()` from `--ink` and must not be redefined per-theme. The QR tokens
`--color-qr-fill`/`--color-qr-bg` are read by JS (receive-view) and stay
light-mode-constant in both themes.

## Project architecture

This is a Nimiq cryptocurrency wallet. It is a no-build, vanilla JS single-page app (no bundler, no framework, no npm). All source files are served as-is.

### Directory layout

```
index.html                  Main wallet entry point
sw.js                       Auto-generated service worker (DO NOT EDIT)
src/
  main.js                   App init: loads WASM, waits for keyguard, registers routes
  router.js                 Hash-based SPA router with race-safe async navigation
  config.js                 Network configs, NIM/luna conversion, BIP44 path
  nimiq.js                  Lazy singleton loader for Nimiq WASM
  security-init.js          Freezes crypto APIs before other scripts (loaded first)
  modules/
    keyguard-api.js         Cross-origin postMessage bridge to keyguard iframe
    network-client.js       Nimiq P2P client singleton (connect, balance, send TX)
    webauthn.js             WebAuthn delegation (keyguard can't call navigator.credentials)
    polygon/                USDC/USDT on Polygon with OpenGSN gas abstraction (mainnet only)
      polygon-abis.js       Trimmed contract ABI fragments
      polygon-client.js     RPC provider w/ endpoint rotation, contracts, chunked getLogs
      gsn-relay.js          Relay ping/discovery (RelayServerRegistered events) + POST /relay
      gsn-fee.js            On-chain fee calc (Uniswap quoter — NO price APIs)
      polygon-send.js       Transfer orchestration: nonces → fee → keyguard → relay → receipt
      polygon-history.js    IndexedDB-cached Transfer-log history w/ GSN fee folding
  views/                    Each view is an async function returning HTMLElement or {element, cleanup}
    welcome-view.js         Landing: create, import, or passkey restore
    create-view.js          Delegates to keyguard for mnemonic + password
    import-view.js          Delegates to keyguard for word entry + password
    lock-view.js            Password/passkey unlock on return visits
    dashboard-view.js       Balance, recent TXs, consensus indicator (targeted DOM updates)
    send-view.js            TX form with validation, self-send guard, keyguard signing
    receive-view.js         Address + QR code display
    history-view.js         Last 50 TXs via network client
    settings-view.js        Network toggle, WebAuthn, backup, delete wallet
    batch-send-view.js      Bulk TX: paste/upload addresses, sign once, broadcast
  styles/app.css            Application styles (includes design tokens)
  lib/qr-encoder.js         Native QR encoder, no dependencies
keyguard/                   Deployed to SEPARATE ORIGIN (different GitHub Pages domain)
  index.html                Iframe shell with strict CSP (connect-src 'none')
  src/
    keyguard-app.js         Message handler, renders sensitive UI (passwords, mnemonics, TX confirm)
    keyguard-worker.js      Web Worker: all cryptography, key derivation, IndexedDB storage
    keyguard-polygon.js     Worker-only module: Polygon derivation + EIP-712 signing + validation
    styles/keyguard.css
  lib/ethers/               Vendored ethers v5.7.2 ESM (keyguard copy)
lib/nimiq-core/             Pre-built Nimiq WASM binaries (crypto, consensus, TX building)
lib/ethers/                 Vendored ethers v5.7.2 ESM build + loader (wallet copy)
verify/                     Docker-only EIP-712 vector suite (NOT served; SW-excluded)
scripts/
  deploy.sh                 Cross-origin deploy (pushes keyguard, generates wallet workflow)
  generate-sw.js            Generates sw.js with SHA-256 hashes of all served files
```

### Security model

The wallet and keyguard run on **separate origins** so private keys never leak across the postMessage boundary. The keyguard iframe owns all sensitive operations (key generation, signing, mnemonic display). The wallet never sees raw keys or entropy.

- **Wallet** (main origin): UI, networking, routing. No access to keys.
- **Keyguard** (separate origin): Key storage, cryptography, sensitive UI. No network access (`connect-src 'none'` in CSP).

Both sides validate `event.origin` on every postMessage. The keyguard-worker.js runs in a Web Worker for isolated crypto (IndexedDB stores encrypted entropy, never plaintext keys).

### Key crypto details

- 1 NIM = 100,000 luna. `nimToLuna()` uses string math to avoid float errors.
- BIP44 derivation path: `m/44'/242'/0'/0'` (Nimiq coin type 242).
- Password encryption: nimiq-core's Secret.exportEncrypted.
- Passkey encryption: AES-GCM with PRF-derived key. HKDF for cross-device restore.
- Entropy is zeroed (`.fill(0)`) after use.

### Stablecoins (USDC/USDT on Polygon)

Mainnet-only (`isStablecoinsEnabled()` gates every UI entry; Nimiq never
deployed the Amoy testnet contracts). Gas abstraction via OpenGSN v2 reusing
Nimiq's deployed infrastructure — users pay fees in the token itself:

- Polygon address: `m/44'/60'/0'/0/0`, derived from the SAME entropy,
  **hardcoded in the keyguard** (never a request parameter). Stored as
  `record.polygonAddress`; one wallet-level address, independent of the NIM
  address picker. Existing wallets activate via an authenticated
  `activatePolygon` flow; new wallets auto-derive at create/import/restore.
- 1 USDC/USDT = 1,000,000 base units (6 decimals). `tokenToUnits()` uses the
  same string-math pattern as `nimToLuna()`. All fee math in ethers BigNumber.
- **No price/data APIs**: balances + history via public keyless JSON-RPC,
  POL→token rate via the on-chain Uniswap v3 quoter (`gsn-fee.js`), relay via
  the OpenGSN network (Fastspot relay). Three different nonces exist — USDC
  `nonces()` (EIP-2612), USDT `getNonce()` (meta-tx), and the forwarder
  `transferContract.getNonce()` (goes in `relayRequest.request.nonce`).
- **Keyguard trust boundary**: the wallet builds a relayRequest whose
  calldata has dummy signature fields; `keyguard-polygon.js` validates it
  against hardcoded contract constants (transfer-contract allowlist,
  approval === amount + fee, pctRelayFee ≤ 70, …), renders the confirm UI
  exclusively from its own decoded values, RE-ENCODES the calldata with real
  signatures, and signs the GSN EIP-712 payload. The wallet must submit the
  keyguard-returned relayRequest. The keyguard stays offline.
- **CSP coupling**: `index.html` connect-src is an explicit allowlist that
  MUST stay in sync with `POLYGON.rpcUrls` and `POLYGON.allowedRelayOrigins`
  in `src/config.js`. Adding an RPC/relay = one line in each place.
- ethers v5.7.2 is vendored (NO CDN) in `lib/ethers/` and
  `keyguard/lib/ethers/`; always `await import(...)` it lazily so NIM-only
  users never pay the ~550 KB cost. The SW skips per-fetch re-hashing for it
  (install-time hash still enforced).
- EIP-712 correctness is locked by `verify/eip712-vectors.js` (12 checks:
  parity with @opengsn/common TypedRequestData, on-chain DOMAIN_SEPARATORs,
  tamper rejection). Run it in Docker (`node:24`, see file header) after ANY
  change to `keyguard-polygon.js`.

## Cross-origin deploy

### Origin placeholders

Source files contain literal placeholder tokens replaced at deploy time:

- `[KEYGUARD_ORIGIN]` in wallet files: `index.html`, `src/modules/keyguard-api.js`, `src/modules/webauthn.js`
- `[WALLET_ORIGIN]` in keyguard files: `keyguard/index.html`, `keyguard/src/keyguard-app.js`

If you add a new file that references the other origin, you **must** add a corresponding `sed` substitution in `scripts/deploy.sh`. The wallet workflow is generated by the deploy script's heredoc, so both keyguard and wallet sed lines live in `deploy.sh`.

### Deploy flow

1. `./scripts/deploy.sh` replaces `[WALLET_ORIGIN]` in keyguard files and pushes them to the separate org repo. It also writes `.github/workflows/deploy.yml` locally.
2. The user commits and pushes to trigger the GitHub Actions workflow.
3. The workflow replaces `[KEYGUARD_ORIGIN]` in wallet files, runs `generate-sw.js`, and deploys via GitHub Pages.

### Common pitfalls

- Forgetting to add a `sed` line when a new file uses a placeholder causes silent postMessage failures — the app appears to freeze/do nothing.
- The keyguard `frame-ancestors` CSP and the wallet `frame-src` CSP both use placeholders. If either is wrong, the iframe won't load.

## XSS prevention

- Use `textContent` (not `innerHTML`) for any user-controlled or network-sourced data.
- The keyguard uses `escHtml()` for template literal rendering.
- `index.html` has a strict CSP. Inline scripts need SHA-256 hashes in the CSP header.

## View conventions

- Views are async functions returning `HTMLElement` or `{ element, cleanup }`.
- Views with timers or event listeners must return a `cleanup` function to prevent leaks.
- The router calls cleanup automatically on navigation.
- Most views check `getStoredAddress()` and redirect to `#welcome` if null.
- Disable buttons during async operations to prevent double-submission.
